attributes.title: 2027 Idaho Chapter Annual Scientific Meeting
attributes.series: ACP Idaho Chapter Annual Scientific Meeting
attributes.summary:
The Idaho Chapter of the American College of Physicians holds its 2027 Annual Scientific Meeting from Friday, May 14, to Sunday, May 16, at the Idaho College of Osteopathic Medicine in Meridian, just west of Boise.

The chapter had already put up a registration notice when we checked, but it had not listed credit hours or fees on its page. Internists who practice in Idaho or nearby states can use it to pick up CME close to home. Check the chapter page for the program and current prices.
